motivation: Direct complex data/weighting experiments improve ligand geometry but remain far behind released PVB. Paper describes much richer chemical/geometric pretraining; local released static-pretrain weights are available. Test transfer of that prior, not more random small-head tweaks.
reference_policy: Original PVB code and weights remain unchanged. Candidate owns its loaded geometry and writes only new checkpoints. Explicitly attribute inherited pretrained knowledge.
architecture: Loaded2-layer256-wide geometry encoder and8-layer geometric decoder plus released velocity/drift heads; zero-output-initialized scalar/vector observed-history attention and joint-query attention before shared output heads
history: All supplied observed frames with physical ages; scalar attention weights mix equivariant feature channels and relative observed displacement vectors; no dataset-specific input path
query: Joint generated-state interaction at each bridge evaluation, physical ps distinct from flow progress; no hidden future conditioning
static: Corrupted singleton input, same geometric encoder/decoder/heads, temporal adapters bypassed; clean structure only enters loss
objective: Preserve released stochastic-interpolant velocity/drift targets and KL. Do not transplant weights into the incompatible coordinate-RF source/target objective.
current_missing_work: Training orchestration and explicit checkpoint loading report
Complete mixed-data recipe and fixed training budget
Real CUDA training; start from actual training, not a new smoke/unit-test campaign
initial_training_design_not_yet_submitte: Use completed expanded TRAIN corpus and the existing protein TRAIN store; system-equal data visits and true stored physical clocks, H4/H8 dynamic clips plus corrupted TRAIN singletons. Increase training exposure beyond2048; retain fixed final and one rolling recovery checkpoint. Final budget/controls must be explicit before submission. No new validation-based truncation or best-of-N sampling.
environment: Local enter-container/torch-ito; when loading released objects use the already-working PVB numpy126 overlay and original source path, not dependency upgrades.
current_limits: Uniform unpadded H/Q per packed batch; H may vary between batches
No Mamba replacement in this experiment
Published static-pretraining exposure may overlap future evaluation families
literature_context: PVB reports58,576 training protein monomers and12,826 training crystal complexes, plus large small-molecule datasets; MISATO uses original13765/1595/1612 split. These are paper descriptions, not a reconstructed exact optimizer history of the downloaded checkpoint.
